# CI: Build, Lint & Test
# Runs on every push and PR to main/develop branches

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  # ─── Web Platform ───────────────────────────────
  web-platform:
    name: Web Platform (Build + Test)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Lint
        run: npm run lint

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build
        run: npm run build

  # ─── VS Code Extension ─────────────────────────
  extension:
    name: Extension (Build + Test)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: tokalator-extension-vs
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: tokalator-extension-vs/package-lock.json

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run unit tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build extension
        run: npm run compile

name: Bi-monthly Wiki Fetch

on:
  schedule:
    # 1st and 15th of every month at 06:00 UTC
    - cron: "0 6 1,15 * *"
  workflow_dispatch: # allow manual trigger

jobs:
  fetch:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pip install -r scripts/requirements.txt

      - name: Run agentic wiki fetcher
        env:
          GOOGLE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.GOOGLE_API_KEY }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: python scripts/fetch-wiki-agent.py

      - name: Commit updated articles
        run: |
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add content/wiki/articles.json
          git diff --cached --quiet || git commit -m "chore: wiki fetch $(date +%Y-%m-%d)"
          git push

### 1. BUILD/LINT/TEST COMMANDS

- watch             — Watch mode compilation
- lint              — ESLint for src/
- test              — Jest for __tests__/
```

**MCP Server (tokalator-mcp) package.json:**
```
- build             — TypeScript compilation (tsc)

### 2. HIGH-LEVEL ARCHITECTURE

**Three major subsystems:**

1. **Next.js Web Platform (tokalator.wiki)**
   - Dashboard displaying token usage, pricing, context engineering tools
   - Auto-discovered catalog of agents, prompts, instructions, collections
   - Interactive calculators (token, caching, conversation estimator, cost)
   - Educational wiki on context engineering terms
   - Built with React 19, Tailwind v4, Recharts for charts, Prisma 7 for DB

2. **VS Code Extension (tokalator-extension-vs)**
   - Sidebar dashboard showing real-time context budget and file relevance scores
   - Chat participant `@tokalator` with 11 commands (count, optimize, pin, breakdown, instructions, model, etc.)
   - Tab relevance scorer using multi-factor algorithm (language, imports, path, recency, diagnostics)
   - Model auto-sync with Copilot chat window
   - Session logger for research studies (opt-in, anonymized aggregate counts)

3. **MCP Server + CLI (tokalator-mcp)**
   - Standalone tool for token counting in Claude Code and terminal
   - 4 tools: `count_tokens`, `estimate_budget`, `preview_turn`, `list_models`
   - Real Claude BPE tokenizer via @anthropic-ai/tokenizer
   - CLI with full markdown report generation

**Data Flow:**
- Scanner walks project directories → detects .agent.md, .prompt.md, .instructions.md, .collection.yml files → parses frontmatter → caches in-memory catalog
- Extension monitors editor state → scores tabs → estimates token budget → displays in sidebar
- API (FastAPI) handles CSV uploads and econometric calculations

### 3. KEY DIRECTORIES & PURPOSE

**Root structure:**
- `/app` — Next.js App Router pages (/, /agents, /prompts, /instructions, /collections, /tools/*, /extension, /about, /learn, /wiki, /dictionary)
- `/components` — React components (calculators, trackers, charts, catalog UI, side-nav)
- `/lib` — Shared TypeScript utilities (pricing, context, conversation, caching, catalog/scanner, i18n, providers, market-data)
- `/lib/catalog` — Scanner system (frontmatter parser, directory walker, item deduplicator)
- `/scripts` — Build & dev utilities (fetch-wiki.ts, fetch-wiki-agent.py, evaluate-scorer.ts, snapshot collection)
- `/content` — JSON data files (homepage.json, site.json, events.json, extension.json, dictionary.json, wiki/articles.json)
- `/prisma` — Database schema (currently excluded from build due to v7 breaking changes; schema.prisma present but lib/db.ts not used)
- `/api` — FastAPI Python backend (routers: csv_upload, economics; models.py for Pydantic schemas)
- `/tokalator-extension-vs` — VS Code extension source
  - `/src/core` — Core logic: contextMonitor.ts, tabRelevanceScorer (pure + wrapper), tokenBudgetEstimator, sessionLogger, tokenizerService
  - `/src/webview` — Sidebar dashboard React component
  - `/src/chat` — Chat participant implementation
- `/tokalator-mcp` — MCP server & CLI
  - `/src/core` — TokenizerService
  - `/src/tools` — countTokens, estimateBudget, previewTurn, listModels
  - `/src/cli.ts` — CLI argument parsing & report generation
- `/evaluation` — Scorer evaluation framework (snapshots, labels, analysis scripts)
- `/copilot-contribution` — Built-in catalog of agents, prompts, instructions
- `/user-content` — User-contributed items (scanned if present)

### 4. EXISTING DIRECTIVE FILES

**No CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or GitHub Copilot instructions found at root level.** However:
- Scanner auto-detects CLAUDE.md files in project root and .claude/ directories
- Scanner looks for `.github/skills`, `.claude/skills`, `.copilot/skills` directories (VS Code 1.109+ Skills format)
- `/app/extension` folder documents VS Code extension features

### 5. CATALOG/SCANNER OPERATION

**Location:** `/lib/catalog/scanner.ts`, `/lib/catalog/frontmatter.ts`

**File Detection Patterns:**
- `.agent.md`, `.prompt.md`, `.instructions.md` → content kind (agent, prompt, instruction)
- `.collection.yml` or `.collection.yaml` → collection
- `CLAUDE.md` → instruction (auto-detected)
- `SKILL.md` → skill (VS Code 1.109+ compatible)

**Scanning Process:**
1. Loads `catalog-config.json` (lists featured IDs and scan directories)
2. Walks configured directories (copilot-contribution, user-content, awesome-copilot) recursively
3. Parses frontmatter: `---\nname: Foo\ndescription: Bar\ntags: [a, b]\n---`
4. For YAML collections, parses with `yaml` npm package
5. Detects ecosystem (claude-code if path contains "claude" or source is CLAUDE.md, copilot if contains "copilot", else universal)
6. Caches in memory per session, indexed by slug (generated from filename)
7. Computes stats by kind/ecosystem/source
8. Returns Catalog object with items array + stats + lastScanned timestamp

  "featuredIds": ["context-architect", "context-map", "what-context-needed", "refactor-plan"],
  "scanDirectories": [

1→# Tokalator
     2→
     3→**Count your tokens like beads on an abacus.**
     4→
     5→Real-time context budget monitoring for VS Code. Shows where your AI context budget is going, scores tab relevance, and syncs to the active Copilot model automatically — so you always know how much room you have left.
     6→
     7→156 marketplace acquisitions · 82.98% page-to-install conversion · 124 unit tests · 3 community sessions (220+ developers)
     8→
     9→## The Problem
    10→
    11→AI coding assistants have finite context windows. When you have 30 tabs open, your assistant's attention is diluted across irrelevant files — and you can't see what's happening. Context rot sets in silently: the model's performance degrades as conversation turns accumulate stale context.
    12→
    13→Tokalator fixes this. Real BPE tokenizers (not guesses), per-file breakdowns, and automatic cleanup.
    14→
    15→## Features
    16→
    17→### 1. Token Budget Dashboard
    18→
    19→Sidebar panel showing your context usage at a glance:
    20→
    21→- Budget level: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH with token counts
    22→- Next turn preview — cost estimate before you send
    23→- Files ranked by relevance to your current task
    24→- One-click tab cleanup
    25→- Per-turn context growth chart
    26→- Budget breakdown: files, system prompt, instructions, conversation, output reserve
    27→- Session summary on activation (last model, turns, peak usage)
    28→- High Contrast theme support
    29→
    30→### 2. Model Auto-Sync
    31→
    32→Tokalator automatically detects the model active in the Copilot chat window and updates its context window, tokenizer, and rot threshold — no manual selection needed. Switch from Claude Opus to Sonnet in Copilot and the budget numbers update instantly.
    33→
    34→### 3. Chat Commands (`@tokalator`)
    35→
    36→11 commands covering the full context management workflow:
    37→
    38→| Command | Description |
    39→| --- | --- |
    40→| `@tokalator /count` | Token count and budget level |
    41→| `@tokalator /breakdown` | Where tokens are going |
    42→| `@tokalator /optimize` | Close low-relevance tabs |
    43→| `@tokalator /pin <file>` | Pin a file as always-relevant |
    44→| `@tokalator /unpin <file>` | Unpin a file |
    45→| `@tokalator /instructions` | List instruction files with token cost |
    46→| `@tokalator /model [name]` | Show or switch model |
    47→| `@tokalator /compaction` | Per-turn growth and compaction advice |
    48→| `@tokalator /preview` | Preview next turn cost |
    49→| `@tokalator /reset` | Reset session turn counter |
    50→| `@tokalator /exit` | End session and save summary |
    51→
    52→### 4. Tab Relevance Scoring
    53→
    54→Each open tab is scored R ∈ [0, 1] based on:
    55→
    56→| Factor | Weight |
    57→| --- | --- |
    58→| Same language as active file | 0.25 |
    59→| Import relationship | 0.30 |
    60→| Path similarity | 0.20 |
    61→| Edit recency | 0.15 |
    62→| Has diagnostics | 0.10 |
    63→
    64→Pinned and active files always score 1.0. Files below the threshold (default 0.3) are flagged as distractors.
    65→
    66→### 5. Instruction File Scanner (`/instructions`)
    67→
    68→Detects files silently injected into every prompt and shows their real token cost:
    69→
    70→`.github/copilot-instructions.md` · `CLAUDE.md` · `AGENTS.md` · `.cursorrules` · `*.instructions.md`
    71→
    72→### 6. MCP Server + CLI
    73→
    74→Brings Tokalator into Claude Code and terminal workflows. See the [MCP & CLI section](https://tokalator.dev/extension#mcp).
    75→
    76→## Tokenizers
    77→
    78→| Provider | Models | Tokenizer |
    79→| --- | --- | --- |
    80→| Anthropic | Opus 4.6, Sonnet 4.5/4, Haiku 4.5 | Claude BPE (`@anthropic-ai/tokenizer`) |
    81→| OpenAI | GPT-5.2, GPT-5.1, GPT-5 Mini, GPT-4.1, o3, o4-mini | o200k_base (`js-tiktoken`) |
    82→| Google | Gemini 3 Pro/Flash, 2.5 Pro | Heuristic (~4 chars/token) |
    83→
    84→## Supported Models (14 profiles)
    85→
    86→Claude Opus 4.6 · Claude Sonnet 4.5 · Claude Sonnet 4 · Claude Haiku 4.5 · GPT-5.2 · GPT-5.2 Codex · GPT-5.1 · GPT-5 Mini · GPT-4.1 · o3 · o4-mini · Gemini 3 Pro · Gemini 3 Flash · Gemini 2.5 Pro
    87→
    88→## Usage
    89→
    90→1. **Sidebar** — click the abacus icon in the Activity Bar
    91→2. **Chat** — type `@tokalator` in Copilot Chat
    92→3. **Status bar** — live token count in bottom-right (click to refresh)
    93→
    94→## Settings
    95→
    96→| Setting | Default | Description |
    97→| --- | --- | --- |
    98→| `tokalator.model` | `claude-opus-4.6` | Active model (sets window, tokenizer, rot threshold) |
    99→| `tokalator.relevanceThreshold` | `0.3` | Score below which tabs are flagged as distractors |
